raw_segments.text: Constable, O peace, Prince Dauphin, you are too much mistaken in this king.
Question your grace, the late ambassadors, with what great state he heard their embassy,
how well supplied with noble counselors, how modest an exception, and with all how terrible
in constant resolution, and you shall find his vanities force-bent were but the outside
of the Roman Brutus, covering discretion with a coat of folly, as gardeners do with orger
hide those roots that shall first spring and be most delicate.
